story_prototype.place: Hrushivka and Hrushivskyi Kut (flooded 1955-56 by the Kakhovka reservoir; resettled uphill as Leninske, renamed Hrushivka in 2016)
story_prototype.note: Dovzhenko lived in Leninske (Hrushivka) in 1954-1955 and wrote the screenplay there; 678 households of Hrushivka and Hrushivskyi Kut were moved uphill. The old villages lay lower on the Velykyi Luh floodplain at the Bazavluk mouth and are re-emerging since the 2023 dam breach. The film itself was shot at Buchak in 1957 (Dovzhenko died in 1956).
